what_it_is_about: One modifier that counts only against a target carrying a tag, and one that counts only from a source carrying one. Four combinations, because a qualification that was read from the wrong side would be right in two of them.
not_verified_because: Not measured. The harness could not make a modifier's own tag requirement count, and proved that rather than guessing: a plain modifier across the same source-to-target path applies (attack 10 -> 15), while a modifier whose target requirement IS met answers 10 - with the tag added before the effect and again with it added after, and with the target's owned tags read back as `Status.Burning` both times. Four identical variants are what a harness that applied nothing says, so they are not written here as what Unreal decided.
